_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/Roaster/tools/make_shape.py. Every element was made for the Seraph Horizons mod. Every tier's parts are in this one shape, the stalls of tier 2 where the furnace of tiers 3 and 4 stands: a renderer draws the fitted tier's. The fire's texture code is 'fire': a renderer may set it to ember while the furnace burns. Keep element names when editing: the rig finds its parts by them.
